hero.title: Electronics & Communication (UG) in Mauritius
hero.subtitle: A Bachelor’s in Electronics Engineering in Mauritius is a good undergraduate choice for students interested in electronic circuits, embedded systems, microprocessors, telecommunications, sensors and intelligent devices. **A Bachelor’s in Electronics Engineering in Mauritius for Indian Students** can be a suitable option for those who want to build a career in electronics and modern technology.

overview: One of the relevant options is the BEng (Hons) Electronic Engineering at the University of Technology, Mauritius (UTM) which lists a four year full time program. The University of Mauritius also offers a four-year BEng (Hons) Electrical and Electronic Engineering for the academic year 2026-2027. These are related qualifications so students should look at the curricula of the courses before deciding to take a course specifically in electronics. Students planning to **Study Electronics Engineering in Mauritius** should compare these programs carefully. **Edu-Hawk Worldwide** can help students explore their international study options.

faq.question: How many years is a Bachelor’s degree in Electronics Engineering in Mauritius?
faq.answer: UTM says its BEng (Hons) Electronic Engineering is a four year full time program. The University of Mauritius also offers a 4-year degree course in Electrical and Electronic Engineering.

faq.question: Which university in Mauritius offers Electronics Engineering?
faq.answer: The BEng (Hons) Electronic Engineering program is offered by the University of Technology, Mauritius. The relevant BEng (Hons) in Electrical and Electronic Engineering is offered by the University of Mauritius. These are the Electronics Engineering Universities in Mauritius that students can compare.

faq.question: What are the eligibility criteria for Indian students?
faq.answer: Normally applicants should have passed Class 12 or equivalent with Mathematics and Physics. For its Electronic Engineering program, UTM requires passes at principal-level in Mathematics and Physics at HSC/GCE A-level or equivalent qualification. Students should verify the Electronics Engineering Eligibility in Mauritius with the university.

faq.question: What is the cost of studying Electronic Engineering in Mauritius in Indian Rupees?
faq.answer: UTM’s published international fee schedule estimates tuition and general and student union fees at about US\$3,270 (₹2.84 lakh) per year, based on two semesters. Estimated living expenses could be around ₹4.67–₹8.89 lakh per annum. Check what fees and exchange rate are applicable before planning.

faq.question: What can I do after Electronics Engineering?
faq.answer: The graduates can be employed in electronics design, embedded systems, hardware testing, telecommunications, instrumentation, PCB design and industrial automation. Technical skills, practical experience and employer requirements determine career choices.
